scripts.ios:check-xcode-version: sh -c 'XC_VERSION=$(xcodebuild -version | awk "/^Xcode/ {print \$2}"); MIN_XC=26.4; if [ "$(printf "%s\n%s\n" "$MIN_XC" "$XC_VERSION" | sort -V | head -n1)" != "$MIN_XC" ]; then echo "⚠️ Xcode ≥ $MIN_XC is required for Expo SDK 56. You have $XC_VERSION. You can bypass this check by running \"pnpm ios:run\" but you may encounter native build errors."; exit 1; fi'
